title: HeteRo-Select: Informativeness as the Participation Driver in Heterogeneous Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2508.06692v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated learning systems typically allocate gradient compression by link speed. This is sensible when bandwidth and data informativeness align. However, under non-IID data, these signals often decorrelate or invert. A bandwidth-driven allocator then risks compressing the most informative gradients hardest. We propose HeteRo-Select, a framework that replaces bandwidth with a per-client informativeness score as the primary driver of compression. The score jointly governs three decisions per round: client selection, compression ratio, and server aggregation weight, with bandwidth retained only as a hard ceiling. Score-proportional selection provably reduces the effective heterogeneity of the chosen subset; score-proportional compression provably lowers aggregate top-$k$ error at fixed traffic. Under the exact FedCG simulation protocol, HeteRo-Select delivers a $1.78\times$ speedup and an $18.2\%$ reduction in traffic on CIFAR-10. The

translated_title: HeteRo-Select：异构联邦学习中信息量作为参与驱动因素
translated_abstract: 联邦学习系统通常根据链路速度分配梯度压缩。当带宽和数据信息量一致时，这种方法是合理的。然而，在非独立同分布（non-IID）数据下，这些信号往往去相关或反转。基于带宽的分配器可能风险性地压缩信息量最大的梯度。我们提出了HeteRo-Select框架，该框架用每个客户端的信息量分数替代带宽作为压缩的主要驱动因素。该分数每轮联合控制三个决策：客户端选择、压缩比率和服务器聚合权重，带宽仅作为硬性上限保留。分数比例选择可证明减少所选子集的有效异质性；分数比例压缩可证明在固定流量下降低聚合top-$k$误差。在精确的FedCG模拟协议下，HeteRo-Select在CIFAR-10上实现了$1.78\times$的加速和$18.2\%$的流量减少。
tldr: 提出了一种以客户端信息量分数为核心驱动压缩、选择和聚合的框架，显著提升了异构联邦学习的效率并降低了通信成本。
en_tdlr: Proposed a framework driven by per-client informativeness scores for compression, selection, and aggregation, significantly improving efficiency and reducing communication cost in heterogeneous federated learning.
